items.title: The module on the scheme theoretic support of a coherent sheaf on a locally Noetherian algebraic space is coherent

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the quasi-coherent module cut out on the scheme theoretic support of a coherent sheaf by the pushforward identification remains coherent (statement lines 2234-2244). The proof checks that the support is locally Noetherian, using that a closed immersion is locally of finite type, and then applies the characterization of coherence by finite type on a locally Noetherian space. The bookkeeping of the two hypotheses (locally Noetherian support, finite type module) is the substance, so the claim is H2.
